`final class UIDataOverlayInteractionObject`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataOverlayInteractionObject.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataOverlayInteractionObject.java)

The input options of an overlay for a running UI.

## Description

[`UIDataOverlayObject.interaction`](/reference/annotations/uidataoverlayobject/#UIDataOverlayObject-method-interaction) returns it.

## Learn more

- [Overlays and popups](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/overlays-and-popups/)

|---|---|---|
| [`UIDataOverlayInteractionObject`](/reference/annotations/uidataoverlayinteractionobject/) | [create](#UIDataOverlayInteractionObject-factory-create)() <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span> | Creates the options with the default values of [`UIDataOverlayInteraction`](/reference/annotations/uidataoverlayinteraction/). |

<a id="UIDataOverlayInteractionObject-properties"></a>

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [active](#UIDataOverlayInteractionObject-property-active) | `boolean` | `false` | If `true`, the overlay receives the input. |
| [cancelClick](#UIDataOverlayInteractionObject-property-cancelClick) | `boolean` | `true` | If `true`, a mouse input that the overlay consumed does not reach the host. |
| [cancelScroll](#UIDataOverlayInteractionObject-property-cancelScroll) | `boolean` | `true` | If `true`, a wheel turn that the overlay consumed does not reach the host. |
| [cancelKeyboard](#UIDataOverlayInteractionObject-property-cancelKeyboard) | `boolean` | `true` | If `true`, a key or a character that the overlay consumed does not reach the host. |
